purpose: Research handoff only; main agent applies production changes.

methodology.publication_date_policy: Absolute publication/update dates only when visible. Relative 'updated yesterday' labels retained verbatim; never convert crawl dates into publication dates.
methodology.fact_evidence: Each fact lists source IDs, URLs, source publication dates, and read/check date. A null publication date means not displayed, not today's date.
methodology.benchmarks: No benchmark scores imported. Vendor benchmark tables remain vendor claims even when they name an independent benchmark. Agent/harness/model/config combinations must not become model-only scores.
methodology.licenses: Hosted access does not grant a model-weight license. Documentation/code footer licenses do not license model weights.
methodology.coverage: Existing board Western rows plus material new text-model releases; not an exhaustive audio/image/embedding catalog. Subscription groups cover every existing group, including Chinese providers.
